user.title: Set up Contact API
user.description: Paste the Discord incoming webhook URL that contact-form submissions should be relayed to. Home Assistant will create a webhook endpoint for your website's server to post to - the URL is shown after setup.

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a Discord webhook URL (expected https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...).
error.webhook_not_found: Discord says this webhook doesn't exist. Double-check the URL.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Discord to verify the webhook. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
